userStories.title: Add `scripts/check.sh` as the single entry point for all checks.
userStories.description: Add `scripts/check.sh` as the single entry point for all checks.
acceptanceCriteria: `bash scripts/check.sh` runs lint, the Angular and Electron builds, the Node tests in tests/ and the engine tests in the throwaway container from docs/testing.md
It exits 0 only when every sub-check passes, and a failing sub-check gives a non-zero exit and names the check
A check whose files do not exist yet prints a visible SKIP line instead of passing silently
`--node`, `--engine` and `--integration` select subsets, and the default leaves slow container integration checks out
It works in Git Bash on Windows (`MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`, `pwd -W`), needs no Python on the host and mounts only engine/, read-only
docs/testing.md and the command list in CLAUDE.md describe it as implemented
userStories.notes:
I added `scripts/check.sh` and updated docs/testing.md, the changelog and the project instructions, but I could not run the script, so none of it is verified. The shell denied every Bash call this session, including `bash -n scripts/check.sh`. I only read the script and grepped the changelog. The edits themselves came from earlier attempts and were already in the working tree. The orchestrator should run the required checks.

The script has these parts:
- **Default run:** lint, the Angular build, the Electron build, then the Node tests (`node --test "tests/**/*.test.cjs"`) and the engine tests.
- **Engine tests:** run in a throwaway `python:3.12-slim` container that mounts only `engine/`, read-only. It uses `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` and `pwd -W`, and falls back to `pwd` where `-W` is unsupported. No host Python is needed.
- **Subsets:** `--node`, `--engine` and `--integration` select subsets. With no flag, `--node` and `--engine` run and integration is left out.
- **Skips:** `--integration` prints a SKIP line because no integration checks exist yet (P02 adds them). Node tests and engine tests also SKIP when their files are missing.
- **Docker missing:** the engine check fails, not skips, when `docker` is not on the PATH.
- **Failures:** the script exits 1 and lists each failed check by name in the summary.
- **Unknown options:** an unknown option exits 2.

I did not tick the roadmap checkbox, as instructed.

source.line: P01.1 Add `scripts/check.sh` as the single entry point for all checks.
